openings.claim: Distinguish historical membership errors from rename recognition; a private center/week manifest could select intended course identities independently of current assignments and names.
openings.discriminator: Hold intended membership fixed; vary assignment/name, then compare exported membership and coordinator recognition.
openings.fit: Uncertain: requires persistent identities, authorization per identity and affordable implementation.
openings.probe: Compare incumbent/manifest on fabricated unchanged, reassigned, renamed and split courses; measure omissions, foreign rows and total selection/checking effort during concurrent attendance entry.
openings.uncertainty: Association is not causation; timetable correctness, intended-set agreement and coordinator recognition remain unresolved.

openings.claim: Authorized direct dispatch/download through the existing runner could shorten replacement delivery; its handling-time benefit depends on active request/follow-up effort.
openings.discriminator: Separate active checking, correction, requesting, downloading and importing from passive waits.
openings.fit: Uncertain: bounded, deduplicated requests must fit existing hosting and six engineer-days.
openings.probe: Use six coordinators in two short fabricated sessions; compare request/start/completion/download timestamps and active effort; test duplicates, unauthorized centers and concurrent attendance.
openings.uncertainty: Import or checking may dominate; faster delivery may leave accuracy and handling unchanged; fabricated tasks may differ from practice.
